VI.description: An IMAQdx property node fed by IMAQdx Open Camera.vi's Session Out - the driver's IMAQdx.ctl TYPEDEF around the session refnum. The composer typed the node with the bare class refnum then and the VI did not load (Memory is full); it reads through the typedef now. A camera name that does not exist makes Open Camera answer IMAQdx's own error, which the node passes on.

Node.inputs: IMAQdx Session:4202.Session Out,error in (no error):4202.error out,Camera Attributes\3AActive Attribute:4201.value
Node.outputs: Camera Attributes\3ADisplay Name:4203.DisplayName,IMAQdx Session:4203.IMAQdx Session,error out:4203.error out
